I couldn't build the HWPX file, so nothing has been saved to your folder yet.

The tool that builds it is a Python script. Every attempt to run it was held for approval, and none went through. The plain `python3` command also doesn't work on this PC. Python is installed at `C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python313\python.exe`, and that is the one I tried.

I did write the full content for the notice and saved it as `skate.json` in this folder. It has:
- **Greeting and deadline box:** reply by 12월 2일(수).
- **Overview table:** 2026. 12. 9.(수) 09:00∼14:00, 시립 실내빙상장, all 2nd graders, chartered bus, 참가비 8,000원.
- **Daily schedule table:** departure, putting on skates and warm-up, basic lessons, free skating, lunch, return.
- **What to bring and safety notes:** gloves, thick socks, lunch and a water bottle; helmet use, how to fall safely, health notes and shoe size.
- **Contact line, date and sender:** dated 2026. 11. 23., from 우리초등학교장.
- **Reply slip (회신서):** grade/class/number, student name, 참가/불참, shoe size, health notes and guardian signature.

The date, place, fee, deadline and schedule times are example values I made up. You'll need to replace them with the real ones.

If you allow that Python command to run, I'll build the file as `2학년_스케이트_체험학습_안내.hwpx`, check it, and send you the list of places to change. You can also tell me to run it another way.
